However, whether such models are truly aware of the 3D structure underlying visual observations, rather than simply reproducing plausible 2D projections, remains an open question. In this work, we investigate this question through human motion control, a task that requires precise modelling of 3D human geometry, motion, camera viewpoint, and scene context. Unlike prior methods that rely on rendered 2D motion guidance videos, we propose a render-free framework that conditions video generation directly on compressed 3D human mesh tokens. This representation preserves full 3D geometric information while enabling a unified token-based generation pipeline that processes video tokens jointly with motion tokens in a DiT-based architecture. This design requires the model to reason jointly about appearance, 3D structure, and camera viewpoint during video generation. Experimental results demonstrate strong performance on human motion control benchmarks, while reducing artifacts induced by view-dependent 2D guidance and trajectory-pose mismatches during editing. These findings suggest that video diffusion models, when equipped with mesh tokenization, can better capture complex 3D human structures and their interactions with the surrounding environment.

</details>


### [232] [Distortion-Aware Fusion of Statistical and Vision-Language Features for Blind Image Quality Assessment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.02002)
*Bishr Omer Abdelrahman Adam,Xu Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出一种基于乘性门控机制的失真感知融合框架，将自然场景统计（NSS）描述符与SigLIP、CLIP-H两种视觉-语言模型嵌入自适应融合，在多个BIQA基准上达到或超越SOTA，且门控权重与逐失真分析结果高度一致。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: NSS描述符与VLM嵌入在图像质量感知上存在互补性，但两者是否有协同增益以及如何根据输入图像自适应分配各自权重，目前尚缺乏研究。

Method: 将138维NSS特征与SigLIP、CLIP-H两种VLM嵌入通过乘性门控机制融合，门控网络根据输入图像内容学习每个流的权重；训练采用混合损失（MSE+PLCC+排序损失），无需微调VLM骨干。

Result: KonIQ-10k: SROCC=0.9142, PLCC=0.9279；KADID-10k: SROCC=0.9715, PLCC=0.9733（超越SOTA）；LIVE Challenge: SROCC=0.8527, PLCC=0.8802。门控权重与独立消融实验测得的NSS贡献呈正相关（rho=0.33）。

Conclusion: NSS在噪声、色偏等像素级失真中贡献最大，在色彩饱和度等感知失真中贡献最小；门控网络能自主发现与逐失真分析一致的流-失真亲和模式，验证了自适应融合的有效性。

Abstract: Blind image quality assessment (BIQA) aims to predict perceived image quality without access to a reference image. Classical natural scene statistics (NSS) descriptors and modern vision-language model (VLM) embeddings address this problem from fundamentally different perspectives, yet whether combining them yields complementary benefits and how to weight their contributions per input image remains unexplored. We propose a distortion-aware fusion framework that integrates a 138-dimensional NSS descriptor with two complementary VLM embeddings, SigLIP and CLIP-H, through a multiplicative gating mechanism that learns per-input stream weights conditioned on image content. Unlike static concatenation fusion, the proposed gating network suppresses or amplifies each stream's contribution based on the input, producing weights that correlate positively (Spearman rank correlation rho=0.33) with the per-distortion NSS contribution measured by independent ablation on KADID-10k. The framework requires no end-to-end fine-tuning of the VLM backbones and is trained with a hybrid loss combining mean squared error, Pearson linear correlation, and pairwise ranking objectives. We evaluate on three standard benchmarks: KonIQ-10k (SROCC=0.9142, PLCC=0.9279), KADID-10k (SROCC=0.9715, PLCC=0.9733, surpassing recent state-of-the-art methods), and LIVE Challenge in-the-Wild (SROCC=0.8527, PLCC=0.8802 with cross-dataset pretraining and fine-tuning). A per-distortion analysis on KADID-10k reveals that NSS features contribute most on noise and color-shift distortions where pixel statistics are directly affected, and least on perceptual distortions such as color saturation changes. The learned gate values validate these findings, confirming that the model autonomously discovers distortion-stream affinity patterns consistent with the manual per-distortion study.

</details>


### [233] [AdaCodec: A Predictive Visual Code for Video MLLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.02569)
*Haowen Hou,Zhen Huang,Zheming Liang,Qingyi Si,Chenglin Li,Shuai Dong,Kele Shao,Ruilin Li,Dianyi Wang,Nan Duan,Jiaqi Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出AdaCodec，一种预测性视觉编码接口，通过只在高预测成本时发送完整参考帧、否则用紧凑的P-token编码帧间变化，大幅减少视频MLLM的视觉token冗余，在1/7预算下超越全帧基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视频MLLM将每帧作为独立RGB图像编码，导致相邻帧的视觉token高度冗余（共享对象、背景和布局），急需一种更高效的视频接口来减少重复编码。

Method: 提出预测性视觉编码接口AdaCodec：仅在条件预测成本高时发送完整参考帧（全视觉token），否则编码帧间变化（运动与预测残差）为紧凑的P-token。

Result: 在11个基准测试中，相同token预算下超越Qwen3-VL-8B逐帧RGB基线；1/7预算（32k tokens）下在所有长视频基准上超越224k基线；通用视频基准平均分提升，首token延迟从9.26s降至1.62s。

Conclusion: AdaCodec通过预测性冗余消除，在显著降低计算和延迟开销的同时，保持了甚至提升了视频理解性能，为视频MLLM提供了一种更高效的接口方案。

Abstract: Video is temporally redundant: adjacent frames usually share most objects, background, and layout. Yet existing video multimodal large language models (video MLLMs) usually encode each sampled frame as an independent RGB image, causing visual tokens to repeat content already present in earlier frames. This suggests a more direct video interface: send a full reference frame only when the scene cannot be predicted well from prior context, and otherwise transmit a compact description of inter-frame changes. We call this interface a \emph{predictive visual code}, and instantiate it for video MLLMs as \textbf{AdaCodec}. AdaCodec spends full visual tokens on a reference frame only when its conditional predictive cost is high; otherwise, it encodes inter-frame changes, including motion and prediction residuals, as compact P-tokens. Across all eleven benchmarks, AdaCodec improves over the Qwen3-VL-8B per-frame RGB baseline at a matched visual-token budget. Even at $1/7$ the budget, AdaCodec with 32k tokens surpasses the 224k baseline on all long-video benchmarks; on five general-video benchmarks, it raises the average score while substantially cutting time-to-first-token from 9.26s to 1.62s.

</details>


### [234] [PerBite: A Curated Diagnostic Workflow for Bite-Aware Food Volume Estimation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.02021)
*Ahmad AlMughrabi,Farid Al-Areqi,David Fernández Gómez,Umair Haroon,Marc Bolaños,Ricardo Marques,Petia Radeva*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于视觉的食物体积估计方法，在MetaFood挑战中排名第一，平均Chamfer距离8.31，状态级体积MAPE为33.87%，但消耗体积MAPE为53.74%，表明各评估维度需单独考量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探究视觉上可信的食物网格是否能准确估计实际消耗的食物体积，评估重建流程各环节对体积估计的影响。

Method: 采用SAM 3分割食物和盘子区域；Hunyuan3D/SAM 3D生成无量纲食物网格；以盘子直径为度量尺度；在Blender中移除盘子几何；对剩余网格进行孔洞填充、水密化并积分估计体积。MoGe-2仅作为初始盘子直径估计的辅助线索。

Result: 在34个网格上平均Chamfer距离8.31（刚性ICP无尺度校正），17对前后状态体积MAPE为33.87%，零单调性违规，但消耗体积MAPE为53.74%。

Conclusion: 表面重建、度量尺度、网格清理、水密体积积分与物理消耗一致性应分开评估，以提升膳食评估的可靠性。

Abstract: Can a visually plausible food mesh be trusted to estimate the volume of consumed food? \method investigates this question using selected paired before- and after-consumption states from the MetaFood CVPR 2026 Continuous 3D Reconstruction While Eating Challenge. The submitted workflow follows a curated reconstruction protocol: SAM~3 segments the food and plate regions; Hunyuan3D/SAM~3D generates a dimensionless food mesh; the plate diameter provides the metric scale; the plate geometry is removed in Blender; and the remaining mesh is hole-filled, made watertight, and integrated to estimate volume. MoGe-2 is used only as an auxiliary cue for initial dish-diameter estimation when direct plate measurement is uncertain; it is not the primary scale source for the reported challenge result. \method ranks first, with an average Chamfer distance of 8.31 across 34 meshes using rigid ICP without scale correction. On 17 before- and after-pairs, it achieves 33.87\% state-level volume MAPE and zero monotonicity violations, while consumed-volume MAPE remains 53.74\%. The results show that surface reconstruction, metric scale, controlled mesh cleanup, watertight volume integration, and physical depletion consistency should be evaluated separately for dietary assessment. Source code and evaluation scripts will be available at \href{https://github.com/GCVCG/PerBite-CVPR-MetaFood-2026}{github.com/GCVCG/PerBite-CVPR-MetaFood-2026}.

</details>


### [235] [Ranking vs. Assignment: The Metric Mismatch in Multi-View Object Association](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.02022)
*Matvei Shelukhan,Timur Mamedov,Aleksandr Chukhrov,Karina Kvanchiani*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文指出多视角目标关联任务中，现有评估指标（AP、FPR-95）与实际分配目标存在根本性不匹配，理论证明这些指标即使在分配正确时也可能不完美，而基于Sinkhorn的归一化可使其完美。实验表明优化后处理参数虽能提升AP/FPR-95，但分配级指标（ACC、IPAA）并无相应改进。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有工作在多视角目标关联任务中普遍使用AP和FPR-95等成对排序指标进行模型评估，但这些指标与任务本质的一对一匹配目标存在根本性不匹配，需要揭示并解决这一问题。

Method: 通过理论分析证明AP和FPR-95在分配正确时仍可能不完美、且最优成对排序仍可能导致错误分配；提出使用Sinkhorn归一化作为受控后处理压力测试，仅优化少量后处理参数来验证指标不匹配问题。

Result: 基于Sinkhorn的归一化能使AP和FPR-95达到完美；仅优化后处理参数即可显著提升AP和FPR-95，但分配级指标（ACC、IPAA）并无提升。

Conclusion: 现有AP和FPR-95指标与多视角目标关联的一对一匹配目标不匹配，应关注更直接的分配级评估指标。

Abstract: Multi-view object association is an important computer vision problem that underlies many multi-camera perception tasks. While this task is naturally formulated as a constrained one-to-one matching problem, recent works heavily rely on pairwise ranking metrics like AP and FPR-95 for model evaluation. We highlight a fundamental mismatch between these metrics and the actual assignment objective. Theoretically, we show that AP and FPR-95 can be imperfect even when the assignment is already correct, and that Sinkhorn-based normalization can make them perfect. Conversely, optimal pairwise ranking can still lead to incorrect assignments. We validate this mismatch in practice by using our Sinkhorn-based normalization as a controlled post-processing stress test. We show that optimizing just a few post-processing parameters significantly boosts AP and FPR-95 without corresponding improvements in assignment-level metrics such as ACC and IPAA.

</details>


### [236] [Normality-Preserving Continual Industrial Anomaly Detection via Orthogonal LoRA Banks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.02042)
*Weibai Fang,Haijun Che,Feiyang Ren,Qiancheng Lao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出了一种基于正交LoRA冻结与分层新颖性自适应增长的持续工业异常检测框架，有效解决历史正常性先验漂移和灾难性遗忘问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有持续扩散方法通过重放或约束优化保留知识，但缺乏隔离和保护类别特定正常性先验的显式机制；标准LoRA既不冻结历史正常性子空间，也无法防止新适配器干扰旧适配器。

Method: 提出两个核心模块：1）历史冻结正交LoRA库（HF-OLB）——冻结预训练U-Net和已学LoRA库，将新任务残差约束到历史LoRA子空间的正交补空间；2）分层新颖性自适应库增长模块（HNABG）——分配层依赖的残差容量，仅在残差正常性新颖性超出现有库表达能力时才扩展库。

Result: 在MVTec和VisA数据集上验证有效；在VisA 2x6设置下，图像/像素级A-AUROC达到83.6/91.8，FM分别为3.8/3.9，像素级A-AUROC比SOTA提升3.2点，像素级FM降低1.3。

Conclusion: 该方法能有效在长时序持续分类序列中保留历史正常性先验，性能优于现有方法。

Abstract: Continual industrial anomaly detection with diffusion models suffers from historical normality prior drift and catastrophic forgetting. Existing continual diffusion methods preserve previous knowledge through replay or constrained optimization, but they lack an explicit mechanism for isolating and protecting category-specific normality priors during sequential adaptation. Although low-rank adaptation provides modular residual updates, standard LoRA neither freezes historical normality subspaces nor prevents new adapters from interfering with previous ones. To address this issue, we propose a normality-preserving continual anomaly detection framework based on two modules: History Frozen Orthogonal LoRA Bank (HF-OLB) and Hierarchical Novelty Adaptive Bank Growth module (HNABG). HF-OLB freezes both the pre-trained U-Net backbone and the learned LoRA banks, and constrains new task-specific normality residuals to the orthogonal complement of historical LoRA subspaces. HNABG further allocates layer-dependent residual capacity and expands the bank only when the residual normality novelty exceeds the expressive capacity of existing banks. Extensive experiments on MVTec and VisA demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method. On the challenging VisA 2x6 setting, our method achieves 83.6/91.8 image and pixel level A-AUROC with 3.8/3.9 FM, improving pixel level A-AUROC over the state of the art by 3.2 points while reducing pixel level FM by 1.3. These results show that our method effectively preserves historical normality priors in long horizon continual category sequences.

</details>


### [237] [Attention mechanisms and transfer learning for robust peach leaf damage classification under domain shift](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.02045)
*Adrián Cánovas-Rodriguez,Miguel A. González-Illán,Maria Fernanda García-Cruz,Pedro Nortes Tortosa,José Salvador Rubio-Asensio,Miguel A. Zamora Izquierdo,Juan Antonio Martínez Navarro,Antonio F. Skarmeta*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于深度学习的桃树叶片损伤分类方法，通过构建包含1,366张叶片图像的基准数据集，评估多种深度学习架构，发现EfficientNet系列结合CBAM注意力机制表现最佳，准确率达93.3%。在本地数据集上通过迁移学习，EfficientNetB3+CBAM取得93%的宏F1分数，证明模型具有良好的鲁棒性和泛化能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 气候变化加剧了桃园中的非生物胁迫和生物胁迫（病虫害），这些胁迫常产生视觉上相似的叶片症状，人工诊断困难，尤其在不同环境条件下的多个田地中。因此需要具备强泛化能力的自动化模型来支持农业管理中的早期决策。

Method: 构建了1,366张桃叶图像的基准数据集（6类损伤），评估多种深度学习架构（EfficientNetB0/B3/B5、DenseNet121等），并集成CBAM注意力模块。在本地数据集（180张图像，4类）上采用三种微调策略进行迁移学习，以解决域偏移问题。

Result: EfficientNetB0达到92.9%准确率，EfficientNetB5在少数类上表现最强。DenseNet121达92.6%。CBAM增强的EfficientNetB5实现最佳准确率93.3%。迁移学习中，EfficientNetB3+CBAM在本地域取得93%的宏F1分数。

Conclusion: 基于注意力机制的模型在少数类别上具有更好的鲁棒性，并在不同田间条件下展现出更强的泛化能力，验证了深度学习在桃树叶片损伤自动检测中的有效性和实用性。

Abstract: Artificial intelligence provides a practical framework for crop damage assessment from imagery data, supporting early decision-making in agricultural management. In peach orchards, climate change increases abiotic stress and biotic pressures, including pests and diseases, which often produce visually similar foliar symptoms. This overlap makes manual diagnosis difficult, especially across multiple fields with varying environmental conditions, highlighting the need for automated models with strong generalization ability.
  We propose an image-based classification approach for peach leaf damage detection. A benchmark dataset was created through manual annotation of publicly available images, consisting of 1,366 peach leaves across six damage categories. Several deep learning architectures were evaluated. EfficientNet models achieved the best results, with EfficientNetB0 reaching 92.9 percent accuracy, EfficientNetB3 achieving 91.5 percent, and EfficientNetB5 showing the strongest performance on minority classes. DenseNet121 reached 92.6 percent accuracy. The integration of the Convolutional Block Attention Module (CBAM) improved performance in several backbones, particularly EfficientNetB5 and InceptionV3, while showing limited or negative impact in others. The CBAM-enhanced EfficientNetB5 achieved the best overall accuracy of 93.3 percent.
  To evaluate robustness under realistic conditions, a local dataset of 180 images across four classes was collected, and transfer learning strategies were applied to address domain shift. Three fine-tuning strategies were tested. EfficientNetB3 combined with CBAM achieved the best performance in the local domain, reaching a 93 percent macro F1-score after transfer. Overall, attention-based models showed improved robustness for minority classes and better generalization across different field conditions.

</details>


### [238] [TIDES: Time-Derivative Event Simulation via Deformable Reconstruction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.02058)
*Christopher Thirgood,Dipon Kumar Ghosh,Simon Hadfield*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: TIDES是一种基于动态高斯溅射的连续时间事件相机模拟器，通过显式3D场景表示实现精确的阈值交叉预测，解决现有模拟器的“时间戳批处理”问题，在事件流保真度和下游任务迁移效果上达到最优。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有事件相机数据集稀缺，模拟器大多从帧序列推断事件时间戳，导致快速运动和遮挡下出现“时间戳批处理”失效模式，即多个阈值交叉共享少量离散时间点，模拟精度不足。

Method: 基于动态高斯溅射构建连续时间事件模拟器，直接从3D场景表示推导逐像素强度动态，实现精确阈值交叉预测（单渲染步内多次交叉）；利用3D场景的遮挡信息指导自适应时间步长，在遮挡区域集中计算；通过瓦片级仲裁器模拟有限传感器带宽，再现吞吐量、抖动和事件丢失等真实伪影。

Result: 在RGB-事件配对基准上取得最优事件流保真度；模拟事件在下游真实任务上的迁移效果优于竞争方法。

Conclusion: TIDES通过连续时间建模和显式3D场景表示，有效克服了传统模拟器的离散时间限制，提升了事件模拟的物理真实性和下游任务适用性。

Abstract: Event cameras emit asynchronous events in response to environmental appearance changes. The scarcity of real-world event datasets makes simulation essential. However, most simulators infer event timestamps from frame sequences, forcing many threshold crossings to share a small set of discrete times; a failure mode we term timestamp batching that worsens under fast motion and occlusion.
  We present TIDES, a continuous-time event simulator built on dynamic Gaussian splatting. Because TIDES operates on an explicit 3D scene representation with learnt geometry and motion, it can derive per-pixel intensity dynamics directly from the scene, rather than by differencing rendered frames. This enables accurate threshold-crossing prediction, including multiple crossings per rendering step, without temporal upsampling or frame interpolation. The same 3D scene model reveals where objects partially occlude one another; TIDES uses this to guide adaptive time stepping, concentrating computation only in regions where occlusion dynamics make simple models of brightness change unreliable.
  Finally, we model finite sensor bandwidth using a tile-level arbiter whose throughput, jitter, and event drops reproduce realistic sensor artifacts. Across paired RGB-event benchmarks, TIDES attains state-of-the-art event-stream fidelity. We also show that events simulated by TIDES transfer more effectively to real downstream tasks than competitors'.

</details>


### [239] [Fast and Lightweight Novel View Synthesis with Differentiable Multiplane Image](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.02068)
*Kaidi Zhang,Guanxu Zhu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出基于多平面图像(MPI)的视图合成方法，利用视觉基础模型预测点图进行几何初始化，结合可微优化和一阶扩散处理空洞与伪影，相比3DGS方法速度提升30.7%，模型大小仅为其14.8%，在正面场景下达到竞争性合成质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有NeRF和3DGS方法在渲染速度、模型大小、优化时间和稀疏视图条件下表现不佳，且前馈式3DGS重建产生的数百万高斯分布难以部署在移动设备上。

Method: 重新采用MPI表示场景，利用视觉基础模型预测的点图进行几何初始化，通过可微优化进行训练，并引入一阶扩散来修复稀疏初始化产生的空洞和伪影。

Result: 相比基于高斯的方法，速度提升30.7%，模型大小仅为其14.8%，在正面场景下合成质量具有竞争力。

Conclusion: MPI结合现代视觉基础模型和扩散技术，能在保持高质量视图合成的同时，显著提升速度和减小模型体积，更适合移动端部署。

Abstract: Recently, novel view synthesis has witnessed remarkable progress, with mainstream methods such as Neural Radiance Fields (NeRF) and 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) delivering impressive results. However, these approaches often struggle to balance rendering speed and model size, and their optimization-based training can be highly time-consuming. Furthermore, they typically rely on dense observations, often failing to produce satisfactory results under sparse-view conditions. Although feed-forward reconstruction significantly reduces the optimization time of 3DGS, its pixel-aligned formulation generates millions of Gaussians from a single image, severely limiting its practical deployment on mobile devices. To address these limitations, we revisit the Multiplane Image(MPI) representation, which represents scenes using a compact set of planar layers for efficient novel view synthesis. Leveraging recent advances in visual foundation models, we utilize predicted point maps for reliable geometric initialization, followed by differentiable optimization. To address the issues of holes and artifacts in sparsely initialized MPI, we introduce one-step diffusion, which participates in both the differentiable optimization of MPI and the postprocessing of rendering results. Compared with a representative GS-based method, our approach is 30.7% faster and uses only 14.8% of its model size, while achieving competitive synthesis quality on front-view scenarios

</details>


### [240] [FACT: A Simple and Efficient Framework for Active Finetuning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.02079)
*Wenshuai Xu,You Song,Yuzhuo Cui,Minjie Ren,Qingjie Liu,Zhenghui Hu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出FACT框架，通过分层微调策略解决主动微调中全量微调导致预训练特征扭曲和过拟合的问题，在多个数据集和架构上取得显著提升，尤其在低采样率下ViT模型性能提升超20%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有主动学习研究主要集中在数据选择（主动方面），而统一采用全量微调进行模型适应，这不可避免地因分布偏移扭曲预训练特征，当模型规模相对于微调数据量较大时，过拟合风险显著增加。

Method: 提出FACT，一个三阶段分层微调框架，兼顾效率与简洁性，专为主动微调场景设计。系统研究了冻结特征增强（FroFA）策略，并在多种数据集和架构上进行综合实验。

Result: 在低采样率下，ViT模型在CIFAR10、CIFAR100和ImageNet-1k上性能提升超20%，建立了新的SOTA性能，同时保持参数效率。

Conclusion: 该框架在标注数据稀缺时特别有效，展现出强泛化性和鲁棒性，验证了系统探索微调方法在主动学习中的重要性。

Abstract: The main goal of active finetuning is to improve a pretrained model's performance on a specific task or domain by finetuning it with carefully selected informative or challenging data. Previous research has predominantly focused on the active aspect (i.e., data selection) while uniformly employing full finetuning for model adaptation, which inevitably distorts pretrained features due to distribution shift. This issue becomes particularly pronounced when the model size is large relative to the finetuning data quantity, leading to heightened overfitting risks. To address this critical gap, we formally outline the FiAF task that emphasizes systematic exploration of finetuning methodologies in active learning. We propose FACT, a three-phase hierarchical finetuning framework featuring both efficiency and simplicity, specifically designed for active finetuning scenarios. Our comprehensive experiments span: (1) Three major dataset categories encompassing classic (CIFAR10, CIFAR100, ImageNet-1k), imbalanced (CIFAR10-LT, CIFAR100-LT), and fine-grained (StanfordCars, FGVCAircraft) image classification datasets, each evaluated under 3-5 distinct sampling ratios; (2) Diverse pretrained architectures including Convolutional Neural Network (ConvNeXt), Vision Transformer (ViT), and Vision LSTM (ViL) networks; (3) A systematic investigation of frozen feature augmentation (FroFA) strategies. (4) A comprehensive and rigorous analysis of efficiency and generalizability. The results demonstrate significant improvements with strong generalization and robustness. Notably, under low sampling ratios, our framework achieves remarkable performance gains of over 20% on the ViT model for CIFAR10, CIFAR100, and ImageNet-1k benchmarks. This systematic approach establishes new state-of-the-art performance while maintaining parameter efficiency, proving particularly effective when labeled data is scarce.

</details>


### [241] [FocusDiT: Masking Queries in Diffusion Transformers for Fine-grained Image Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.02090)
*Xueji Fang,Liyuan Ma,Jianhao Zeng,Jinjin Cao,Mingyuan Zhou,Guo-Jun Qi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: FocusDiT提出了一种基于掩码机制的扩散变换器（DiT）优化方法，通过聚焦关键查询令牌（对应复杂细节区域）并仅将其输入FFN层，利用FFN作为视觉语义词汇表来检索和增强细节解码，从而提升细粒度图像生成质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有DiT模型在去噪过程中对所有查询令牌一视同仁，但FFN层实际上充当着视觉语义的"词汇表"，而复杂细节区域（如纹理、边缘）的查询令牌更需要从这些词汇中检索信息。作者认为，聚焦于这些关键令牌并鼓励模型优先优化它们，是实现细粒度视觉生成的关键。

Method: 提出FocusDiT方法，核心是设计一个掩码方案（Masking scheme）：在FFN层前，只将关键查询令牌（对应复杂细节区域）输入FFN，而非关键令牌则被屏蔽。这些被选中的查询令牌能够从FFN的"词汇表"中检索对应的视觉语义嵌入，进而解码出更精细的视觉细节。

Result: 通过大量文本到图像生成实验验证，所提出的令牌掩码机制在生成性能上取得了显著提升，表明该方法能够有效增强模型对细粒度细节的生成能力。

Conclusion: FocusDiT通过有选择地聚焦关键查询令牌并利用FFN的视觉词汇特性，为扩散模型中的细粒度生成提供了一种简单而有效的方法，证明了"少即是多"的令牌选择性处理策略在视觉生成中的价值。

Abstract: Diffusion transformer (DiT) has been widely adopted in the generative diffusion field, advancing the denoising of query tokens through attention and Feed-Forward (\text{FFN}) layers. FFN actually acts as the key-value vocabulary for decoding visual contents where the value embeds the visual semantical knowledge. We present that focusing on critical query tokens corresponding to more complex details and encouraging the model to improve these tokens is essential for fine-grained visual generation. To this end, we propose FocusDiT, which applies a Masking scheme to focus on critical query tokens that are exclusively fed into FFN. The masked queries can retrieve visual tokens from the FFN vocabularies, and use them to decode their visual details. Extensive text-to-image experiments validate the effectiveness of token masking in enhancing generative performance.

</details>


### [242] [WebSpline: Structure-Informed Splines for Real-Time 3D Gaussians from Monocular Videos](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.02096)
*Jongmin Park,Jeonghwan Yun,Minh-Quan Viet Bui,Munchurl Kim*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: WebSpline提出了一种基于结构信息样条（SIS）表示的动态3D高斯框架，通过辅助结构代理图（SPG）实现从单目视频中进行结构连贯、高保真的动态场景重建，在iPhone和NVIDIA基准上达到SOTA渲染质量，且渲染速度比第二名方法WorldTree快10倍以上。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法在单目视频动态场景重建中难以平衡全局结构连贯性与局部细节保真度，且多视图线索有限。

Method: 提出WebSpline框架，核心为结构信息样条（SIS）表示，利用可学习的三次Hermite样条建模每个动态高斯轨迹，并通过辅助结构代理图（SPG）进行结构组织。采用两阶段优化：第一阶段用2D点轨迹初始化SPG并施加时间刚性正则化；第二阶段从优化后的SPG初始化SIS，在空间和结构邻域约束下优化。

Result: 在iPhone和NVIDIA数据集上达到SOTA渲染质量，渲染速度比WorldTree快10倍以上。

Conclusion: WebSpline通过结构信息样条表示和两阶段优化策略，有效解决了单目视频动态场景重建中结构连贯性与细节保真度的平衡问题，实现了高质量、快速的渲染。

Abstract: Dynamic scene reconstruction from monocular videos remains highly challenging, as existing methods often struggle to balance global structural coherence and local fine-grained details under limited multi-view cues. To address this challenge, we propose WebSpline, a novel dynamic 3D Gaussian framework that enables structurally coherent and high-fidelity reconstruction from monocular videos with fast rendering. The core of WebSpline is the Structure-Informed Spline (SIS) representation, which models each dynamic Gaussian trajectory using a learnable cubic Hermite spline whose motion is structurally organized with an auxiliary Structural Proxy Graph (SPG). The proposed framework is optimized in two stages: (i) in the first stage, the SPG is initialized from 2D point tracks and refined with temporal rigidity regularization to establish structural coherence for moving objects across the sequence; and (ii) in the second stage, the SIS representation is initialized from the refined SPG and optimized under both spatial and structural neighborhood constraints. At inference, Gaussian motion is obtained solely by evaluating the learned SIS, enabling fast rendering. Extensive experiments on the challenging monocular dynamic scene benchmarks, iPhone and NVIDIA, demonstrate that our WebSpline achieves state-of-the-art rendering quality while rendering over 10 times faster than WorldTree, the second-best method on the iPhone dataset.

</details>


### [243] [Multimodal Action Diffusion for Robust End-to-End Autonomous Driving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.02105)
*Jorge Daniel Rodríguez-Vidal,Diego Porres,Gabriel Villalonga Pineda,Antonio M. López Peña*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出动作扩散Transformer（ADT），通过多模态动作建模替代传统确定性单动作预测，在闭环驾驶基准上以10倍更低延迟超越此前最先进方法，证明多模态动作建模对端到端自动驾驶既高效又必要。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有端到端自动驾驶系统大多预测中间轨迹路点，依赖手工控制器和GPS；直接预测控制信号（油门、转向、刹车）未被充分探索，且动作多模态性在其中的作用尚不明确。作者认为超越确定性单动作输出不仅是建模选择，更是提升驾驶性能、表征质量和训练稳定性的关键。

Method: 提出Action Diffusion Transformer（ADT），一个无锚点扩散Transformer，使用MSE损失训练，原生建模多模态驾驶动作分布。推理时生成K个动作候选，通过最近邻匹配（NNM）选择最合适的动作，而非直接输出单一确定性指令。

Result: 在闭环Bench2Drive基准测试中超越此前最先进方法，同时实现10倍更低延迟。多模态动作在学到的表征和行为一致性上带来可衡量的收益，这是确定性架构无法复现的。

Conclusion: 表达性的多模态动作建模对于鲁棒的端到端自动驾驶既在实践上高效，也在概念上必要。

Abstract: End-to-End Autonomous Driving (E2E-AD) systems have largely converged on predicting intermediate trajectory waypoints, delegating final control to hand-crafted controllers with GPS access. Direct control-signal prediction (outputting throttle, steer and brake in an end-to-end fashion) remains underexplored, and critically, the role of action multimodality in such systems is not well understood. We argue that moving beyond deterministic, single-action outputs is not merely a modelling choice, but a key driver of driving performance, representational quality, and training stability. To validate this, we introduce the Action Diffusion Transformer (ADT), an anchor-free diffusion transformer trained with a MSE objective that natively models the multimodal distribution of plausible driving actions. Rather than committing to a single deterministic command, ADT generates K action candidates and selects the most suitable one at inference via Nearest Neighbour Matching (NNM). Beyond strong benchmark numbers, we show that action multimodality yields measurable benefits in learned representations and behavioral consistency, effects that deterministic architectures cannot replicate. ADT surpasses previous state-of-the-art on the challenging closed-loop Bench2Drive benchmark while achieving ten times lower latency, demonstrating that expressive, multimodal action modelling is both practically efficient and conceptually essential for robust end-to-end driving.

</details>


### [244] [Understanding-Enhanced Model Collaboration for Long-Tailed Egocentric Mistake Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.02120)
*Boyu Han,Qianqian Xu,Shilong Bao,Zhiyong Yang,Ruochen Cui,Qingming Huang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出了一种理解增强的模型协作方法（UE-MCM），通过大小模型分支协作和互补目标优化，从第一人称视频中检测用户错误动作。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法难以同时高效地理解粗粒度视频上下文和精确推理细粒度动作错误，且错误实例存在长尾分布问题，导致罕见和细微错误难以被检测。

Method: UE-MCM包含小模型分支（CLIP4CLIP + 扩散对比重建）和大模型分支（Qwen3-VL）。小模型联合粗粒度视频和细粒度片段检测局部正确但与整体流程不一致的动作；大模型判断细粒度动作本身是否正确；两者通过轻量协作门自适应融合，并使用重加权交叉熵、AUC导向学习和标签感知调整三个互补目标优化分类器。

Result: 系统在平衡速度与精度的同时，能够有效检测第一人称教学视频中的细微、罕见和模糊错误。

Conclusion: UE-MCM通过大小模型协作和互补目标优化，在细粒度错误检测任务上取得了速度与准确性的良好平衡，尤其适用于长尾分布下的微妙错误场景。

Abstract: In this report, we address the problem of determining whether a user performs an action incorrectly from egocentric video data. To this end, we propose an Understanding-Enhanced Model Collaboration Method (UE-MCM) that combines efficient coarse-grained video understanding with accurate fine-grained action reasoning. Specifically, UE-MCM contains a small model branch and a large model branch. The large model branch focuses on whether the fine-grained action itself is executed incorrectly, while the small model branch jointly takes the coarse-grained video and fine-grained segment as input to identify actions that may be locally correct but inconsistent with the overall workflow. The small model branch is built on a CLIP4CLIP video encoder initialized from a CLIP model enhanced by Diffusion Contrastive Reconstruction, and the large model branch uses the Qwen3-VL Embedding model to extract high-capacity representations from fine-grained action segments. The small-branch prediction and the large-branch prediction are then adaptively fused by a lightweight collaboration gate. To handle the long-tailed distribution of mistake instances, we optimize the classifiers with complementary objectives, including reweighted cross-entropy, AUC-oriented learning, and label-aware adjustment. The resulting system balances speed and accuracy, making it effective for detecting subtle, rare, and ambiguous mistakes in egocentric instructional videos.

</details>


### [245] [Equilibrated Diffusion: Frequency-aware Textual Embedding for Equilibrated Image Customization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.02129)
*Liyuan Ma,Xueji Fang,Guo-Jun Qi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出Equilibrated Diffusion方法，通过频率分解解耦概念特征，实现风格与内容的分离优化，提升图像定制化的主体保真度和文本一致性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有图像定制化方法在微调过程中将概念属性打包成统一潜在嵌入，导致风格、背景等无关干扰难以消除，影响文本-视觉匹配的一致性。

Method: 1) 利用图像频率成分与语义的固有联系，将概念分解为低频（主体内容）和高频（风格）；2) 对各频率嵌入独立优化，使去噪器捕捉剥离风格的主体特征；3) 合并多频率嵌入保持空间定制能力；4) 引入掩码引导扩散限制背景变化；5) 插入残差参考注意力（RRA）保持主体结构和身份一致性。

Result: 在主体保真度和文本对齐指标上超过主流基线方法。

Conclusion: 频率驱动的解耦优化策略能有效分离风格与内容，实现更平衡的图像定制化和更一致的文本-视觉匹配。

Abstract: Image customization learns target subjects from reference concept images and generates conditioned images per text prompts, mainly modifying styles or backgrounds. Prevailing methods adopt fine-tuning to pack diverse concept attributes into a unified latent embedding, yet entangled attributes hinder elimination of irrelevant disturbances from style and background. To address this issue, we propose Equilibrated Diffusion, a frequency-driven approach that disentangles tangled concept features for balanced customization and consistent text-visual matching. Unlike conventional methods learning full concepts with shared embeddings and unified tuning, our work utilizes the inherent link between image frequency components and semantics: low frequencies represent subject content and high frequencies correspond to styles. We decompose concepts in frequency space and optimize each embedding independently. This separate optimization enables the denoiser to capture style detached from subject identity and generalize better to unseen stylistic prompts. Merging multi-frequency embeddings preserves the model's original spatial customization ability. We further deploy mask-guided diffusion to restrict irrelevant background changes and boost text alignment. Residual Reference Attention (RRA) is inserted into spatial attention to retain subject structure and identity consistency. Experiments prove Equilibrated Diffusion exceeds mainstream baselines on subject fidelity and text adherence, verifying our method's superiority.

</details>


### [246] [Ultra Diffusion Poser: Diffusion-Based Human Motion Tracking From Sparse Inertial Sensors and Ranging-Based Between-Sensor Distances](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.02153)
*Dominik Hollidt,Tommaso Bendinelli,Christian Holz*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出Ultra Diffusion Poser模型，利用UWB测距的几何约束进行扩散建模，结合空间布局模块和UWB扩散引导，在惯性动作捕捉中实现关节位置误差降低22%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有稀疏惯性姿态估计方法仅将UWB距离作为额外输入特征，忽略了距离对传感器位置施加的物理几何约束，导致信息利用不充分，估计精度受限。

Method: 1) Spatial Layout Module：从UWB测量中解析重建3D传感器位置；2) UWB-Diffusion Guidance：在扩散采样过程中约束预测姿态与实测距离的一致性；3) 将IMU信号、UWB距离和重建的传感器位置共同作为扩散条件信号。

Result: 在关节位置误差上相比先前工作降低最高22%，达到最先进水平。

Conclusion: 通过显式建模UWB几何约束并引入扩散引导，有效提升了基于IMU的稀疏姿态估计精度，验证了物理约束在扩散模型中的可行性和有效性。

Abstract: Methods using inertial measurement units (IMUs) provide a wearable alternative to camera-based motion capture. To mitigate drift from inertial signals, recent sparse inertial pose estimators integrate inter-sensor distances measured by ultra-wideband (UWB) ranging. So far, UWB distances have only been used as an additional input feature, ignoring the physical constraints they impose on sensor positions. However, these distances can also be used to reconstruct the underlying 3D sensor layout, which in turn provides more informative input for pose reconstruction. We propose Ultra Diffusion Poser, a diffusion model that explicitly models these geometric constraints. It includes a Spatial Layout Module that analytically reconstructs the 3D sensor positions from UWB measurements. These sensor positions are used alongside IMU signals and UWB distances as a conditioning signal during diffusion. Still, network predictions can violate inter-sensor distance measurements. To address this, we introduce UWB-Diffusion Guidance, which encourages alignment between predicted poses and measured distances during diffusion sampling. Together, these contributions enable our model to achieve state-of-the-art performance, reducing joint position error by up to 22% over prior work.

</details>


### [247] [Disentanglement-Based Equivariant Learning for Compositional VQA](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.02168)
*Zhou Du,Zhaoquan Yuan,Xiao Wu,Changsheng Xu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出DEAL框架，通过因果干预解耦视觉和语言概念，并利用等变学习增强组合推理能力，在无附加线索的条件下实现了优于现有方法的组合VQA性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有组合VQA方法忽视底层概念解耦、难以捕捉组合变化机制，且依赖额外线索训练，不适用于真实场景。

Method: 采用因果启发的干预在重编码框架中解耦视觉和文本概念，基于等变性原理对推理输入进行组合变换并对输出施加等变约束。

Result: 在CLEVR-CoGenT和GQA-SGL基准上，DEAL在视觉和语言泛化设置下均优于现有最先进方法。

Conclusion: DEAL仅依赖真实答案监督即可有效提升组合VQA的泛化能力，验证了解耦与等变学习在组合推理中的有效性。

Abstract: Compositional visual question answering (VQA) represents a challenging yet fundamental task that requires models to comprehend novel combinations of previously learned concepts. The current methods often overlook the disentanglement of underlying concepts and are restricted in terms of their ability to effectively capture the compositional variation mechanism. Moreover, the state-of-the-art techniques depend on additional clues for training, which is not feasible in real-world VQA scenarios. To address these issues, in this paper, we introduce a novel Disentanglement-based EquivAriant Learning (DEAL) framework for compositional VQA, which is guided exclusively by ground-truth answers. In DEAL, we employ causality-inspired interventions to disentangle concepts derived from visual and textual inputs within a re-encoding framework. Based on the principle of equivariance, we subsequently perform a compositional transformation on the inference input and impose the equivariant constraint on the output to augment the compositional reasoning capacity of the model. Comprehensive experiments conducted on the benchmark CLEVR-CoGenT and GQA-SGL datasets validate the superiority of our proposed DEAL approach over the existing state-of-the-art methods for compositional VQA tasks in both visual and linguistic generalization settings.

</details>


### [248] [InsightVQA: High-Dimensional Emotion-Cognitive Visual Question Answering Benchmark](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.02171)
*Shiyu Wang,Ziyu Liu,Chaoyi Yu,Yujie Yin,Zhongqian Mao,Jing Chen,Jiaqi Song,Yunshi Lan,Yan Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出InsightVQA，一个面向视觉情绪理解与认知推理的大规模分层VQA数据集（725K QA对），以及InsightVQA-Bench评估基准（30K样本）和InsightNet基线模型，旨在弥补现有基准仅关注情绪识别、缺乏深层推理能力的不足。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视觉情绪理解基准主要聚焦于情绪识别任务，缺乏对情绪产生原因（grounded understanding）以及更高层认知推理（如响应意图预测）的支持，亟需一个能够支撑分层情绪理解与推理的数据集。

Method: 从6个公开来源收集351K图像，经多阶段筛选得到138K高质量图像。采用三级分层标注：感知QA（情绪与效价识别）、接地理解QA（视觉触发词提取+约束引导生成）、认知QA（响应意图预测+序列推理）。共构建725K QA对，并从中精选30K作为InsightVQA-Bench评估集，同时提出InsightNet作为MLLM的情绪调优基线。

Result: InsightVQA在接地情绪理解和认知推理任务上对现有模型构成显著挑战，InsightNet作为基线为后续研究提供了参考基准。

Conclusion: 该工作填补了视觉情绪理解领域缺乏分层推理基准的空白，为更深入的认知级情绪分析研究奠定了基础。

Abstract: Visual emotion understanding requires models not only to recognize emotional states, but also to why they arise and perform higher-level cognitive reasoning. However, existing benchmarks mainly focus on emotion recognition, offering limited support for grounded understanding and response-oriented analysis. To address this gap, we introduce \textbf{InsightVQA}, a large-scale dataset for hierarchical visual question answering on emotion understanding and cognitive reasoning. Building from 351K images collected from six public sources, we apply a rigorous multi-stage filtering pipeline to curate 138K high-confidence images. Each image is annotated at three hierarchical levels: perception QA for emotion and valence recognition, grounded understanding QA constructed from visual trigger extraction through constraint-guided generation, and cognition QA centered on response intent prediction and sequential insight reasoning. In total, InsightVQA contains 725K QA pairs. We further present \textbf{InsightVQA-Bench}, a high-quality evaluation benchmark comprising 30K samples for fine-grained evaluation. To support evaluation, we introduce \textbf{InsightNet}, an emotion-tuned baseline for MLLMs. Results demonstrate that InsightVQA poses significant challenges for grounded emotion understanding and reasoning.

</details>


### [249] [Order within Chaos: Capturing Intrinsic Energy Anomalies for AI-Manipulated Image Forgery Localization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.02178)
*Yiming Wang,Baiqi Wu,Qingming Li,Jiahao Chen,Tong Zhang,Shouling Ji*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出FLAME统一框架，利用扩散过程抑制高频方差的统计特性，通过LAD图捕获异常并结合SAM适配器实现像素级伪造定位，同时提出了EditStream自动合成训练数据的流水线，在AI生成伪造检测任务上达到SOTA水平。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有图像伪造定位方法依赖物理噪声特征，但生成式AI合成的伪造图像缺乏此类噪声，导致传统方法失效。

Method: 1. 理论证明扩散过程会抑制局部高频方差，形成可区分的统计能量间隙；2. 提出FLAME框架，利用LAD图捕获内在异常，结合SAM参数高效适配器实现像素级定位；3. 提出EditStream自动化流水线，持续合成指令式训练数据。

Result: FLAME在AI生成伪造数据集上显著超越此前方法，达到新SOTA，且能有效泛化至未见过的生成架构。

Conclusion: 通过利用扩散模型的固有统计特性，结合SAM适配器与自动化数据合成，可有效解决生成式AI图像伪造定位难题。

Abstract: Recent advancements in generative AI have led to image editing models capable of producing realistic forgeries that evade traditional image forgery localization methods, as these approaches depend on physical noise absent in synthetic data. To address this challenge, we theoretically demonstrate that the diffusion process inherently suppresses local high-frequency variance, creating a statistical energy gap that is distinguishable from the natural entropy of optical imaging. Guided by this insight, we propose FLAME, a unified framework that utilizes a LAD map to capture these intrinsic anomalies, coupled with a parameter-efficient adapter for SAM to achieve precise, pixel-level forgery localization. Furthermore, to bridge the lag between forensic benchmarks and evolving generative models, we introduce EditStream, an automated pipeline for continuous, instruction-based training data synthesis. Extensive experiments demonstrate that FLAME establishes a new state-of-the-art, significantly outperforming previous methods on AI-generated forgery datasets while effectively generalizing to unseen generative architectures. Our code is available at https://github.com/phoenixnir/FLAME.

</details>


### [250] [Symmetry-Aware 9D Pose Estimation with Sim(3)-Consistent Feature and Spherical Inception Convolution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.02219)
*Panfei Cheng,Hongshan Yu,Wenrui Chen,Xiaojun Tang,Jian Liu,Naveed Akhtar*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出SSH-Pose方法，利用大视觉模型（LVM）的语义引导对称点估计实现类别级物体姿态估计，包含平移/尺寸估计器和球形大核卷积特征融合模块，在基准测试和真实场景中达到SOTA性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有实例级方法难以泛化到未见物体，类别级方法受限于Sim(3)空间的非线性和类内变异，需要一种能有效处理这些挑战的通用方法。

Method: (1) 语义引导的对称感知模块利用LVM推断对称点，实现无需形状先验的准确平移和尺寸估计，为旋转估计提供预计算线索；(2) 基于球形大核卷积的特征融合模块，融合LVM语义特征与几何特征，通过长程依赖建模提取关键姿态特征。

Result: 在多个基准测试和真实场景中达到SOTA性能，并成功应用于鲁棒的机器人抓取系统。

Conclusion: 通过将姿态分解为平移/尺寸估计和旋转估计，并利用LVM的强泛化能力，有效降低了类别级姿态估计的难度，实现了对多样物体的准确估计。

Abstract: Object pose estimation is a fundamental problem for an agent system to perceive or manipulate objects in images or videos. However, current instance-level methods struggle with generalization to unseen objects. Category-level methods seek to address this, but remain constrained by the complexities of learning in the non-linear Sim(3) space and intra-class variations. To address these challenges, We propose an effective method for category-level object pose estimation with two key innovations: (1) A translation/size estimator, featuring a semantic-guided symmetry-aware module that leverages robust generalization capabilities of a large vision model (LVM) to infer symmetry points, resulting in accurate translation and size without shape priors. This result serves as a precomputed cue for rotation estimation, thereby reducing the difficulty of learning in the non-linear Sim(3) space and laying a robust foundation for tackling the inherently more challenging rotation estimation. (2) A feature fusion module, based on our proposed spherical large-kernel inception convolution, fuses semantic features from the LVM with systematically computed geometric features to extract essential pose features from intra-class variations by modeling long-range dependencies without excessive computational cost. Built on these innovations, we achieve SOTA on benchmarks and real-world scenes, while developing a robust robotic picking system capable of handling diverse objects. Our code will be available at the project page: {\hypersetup{urlcolor=blue}https://panfei-cheng.github.io/SSH-Pose}.

</details>


### [251] [CORE-MTL: Rethinking Gradient Balancing via Causal Orthogonal Representations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.02221)
*Chengfeng Wu,Tao Zou,Yanru Wu,Jingge Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出CORE-MTL框架，通过因果正交表征将共享表示分解为语义流（任务相关）和残差流（干扰因素），提升多任务学习的泛化能力和负迁移问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有优化中心的多任务学习方法忽视共享表示的内容，无法将任务相关结构与虚假上下文解耦，导致负迁移和泛化能力差。

Method: 提出CORE-MTL，一种因果驱动的表征中心框架，对共享表示进行结构化的语义-残差分解。在视觉领域利用物理先验和统计约束分别约束语义流和残差流。

Result: 理论上有更紧的分布外泛化界，降低了任务梯度干扰；实验上在视觉多任务基准的分布内和分布外设置中均优于现有方法。

Conclusion: CORE-MTL通过因果正交表征分解有效缓解负迁移，提升多任务学习的泛化能力，代码已开源。

Abstract: Multi-task learning (MTL) aims to construct a joint model for multiple tasks by sharing a common representation across domains. To achieve this goal, existing optimization-centric methods either balance task gradients or modify the shared architecture. However, as these approaches remain agnostic to the content of the shared representation, they fail to disentangle task-relevant structure from spurious context, leading to negative transfer and poor generalization. To overcome this limitation, we propose Causal Orthogonal Representations for Multi-Task Learning (CORE-MTL), a causally motivated representation-centric framework that encourages a structured semantic-residual factorization of the shared representation, concentrating task-relevant structure in the semantic stream while relegating nuisance variation to the residual stream. We instantiate this framework in the visual domain by leveraging physical priors for structured scenes and statistical constraints for attributes. Theoretically, our method enjoys a tighter out-of-distribution generalization bound than optimization-centric methods and reduces task gradient interference without explicit gradient projection or reweighting. Empirically, CORE-MTL consistently outperforms existing methods on visual multi-task benchmarks in both in-distribution and out-of-distribution settings. Code is publicly available at https://github.com/Hope-Rita/CORE-MTL.

</details>


### [252] [Chroma Clues: Leveraging Color Statistics to Detect Synthetic Images](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.02224)
*Lea Uhlenbrock,Davide Cozzolino,Christian Riess*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文利用生成模型在色彩统计上的弱点，通过设计颜色变换和特征提取方法，有效检测AI生成图像，平均泛化准确率达93.27%，并具备强鲁棒性和多类别归因能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前AI生成图像快速进化，对图像取证构成挑战，而现有方法忽略了生成模型在色彩统计上的缺陷这一未被充分探索的线索。

Method: 首先分析LPIPS损失对色度不敏感的问题，然后设计六种手工颜色变换和一种任务优化颜色变换，基于这些变换提取像素级或块级特征，用于分类、可视化噪声模式和增强色彩归因。

Result: 简单分类器平均泛化准确率93.27%，对六种后处理具有强鲁棒性；变换可产生自然与合成区域的视觉噪声差异，支持可视化评估和多类别归因。

Conclusion: 基于色彩统计差异的颜色变换方法能有效检测AI生成图像，兼具高准确率、鲁棒性和可解释性。

Abstract: The evolution and dissemination of AI-synthesized images is occurring at an unprecedented rate. Image generators are making rapid progress in their goal of perfectly imitating natural images, which also challenges image forensics.
  In this work, we exploit an underexplored cue in current generative models, namely their weakness to imitate color statistics of natural images. We first show that the LPIPS loss used for training image generators is less sensitive to chrominance than to luminance, which may lead to statistical discrepancies in the colors of synthetic images. Building on this observation, we then introduce six hand-crafted color transformations and a method to learn a task-optimized color transform to statistically expose generated images. These transformations can be used in various ways. First, we define color-sensitive features at pixel-level or patch-level. A simple, interpretable classifier achieves with these features an average generalization accuracy of 93.27% and strong robustness against six types of post-processing. Second, we demonstrate that the transformations exhibit characteristic visual noise patterns in natural and synthetic image areas, which enables an intuitive visual image evaluation. Third, we demonstrate that the transforms can enhance color patterns in generated images for improved multiclass attribution.

</details>


### [253] [Towards Resolving Optimization Conflicts Between Image- and Text-Based Person Re-Identification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.02242)
*Karina Kvanchiani,Timur Mamedov*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种解耦的两阶段训练流程，通过单一视觉编码器联合优化图像-图像（I2I）和文本-图像（T2I）行人重识别，避免了跨任务干扰，并发现I2I预训练和文本监督能提升两种任务的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: I2I和T2I行人重识别存在模态差异和训练目标冲突，导致共享表示学习次优；两者常被独立研究，各自优化的损失函数会相互负面影响。

Method: 提出解耦的两阶段训练流程：基于单一视觉编码器，分别处理I2I和T2I任务，避免训练过程中的跨任务干扰。实验涉及多种领域混合方式、学习策略和任务目标配置。

Result: I2I ReID预训练能提升对T2I数据的泛化能力；在视觉编码器训练阶段引入文本监督可同时提升I2I和T2I的性能。

Conclusion: 该研究为构建统一的行人重识别系统以及跨模态检索提供了有意义的进展方向。

Abstract: The joint optimization of image-based (I2I) and text-based (T2I) person re-identification (ReID) is hindered by modality discrepancies and conflicting training objectives, leading to suboptimal shared representations. While I2I ReID focuses on identity-level invariance across images of the same person, T2I ReID is driven by instance-specific textual descriptions tied to unique visual traits. This paper explores the fundamental difference between two ReID tasks and their optimization processes for effective training. Since I2I and T2I ReID are often studied separately, the loss functions optimized for one retrieval setting may negatively affect the representation quality required by the other. Motivated by these findings, we propose a decoupled two-stage training pipeline for learning a shared representation across image and text modalities. The pipeline is based on a single vision encoder that supports both I2I and T2I retrieval while avoiding cross-task interference during training. We provide extensive experiments across multiple configurations, varying domain mixing procedures, learning strategies, and task objectives. We observed that I2I ReID pre-training positively impacts the generalization ability to T2I data. Besides, we find that incorporating textual supervision during the vision encoder training stage enhances both I2I and T2I performance. We believe our insights provide a meaningful step toward unified ReID systems and cross-modal retrieval overall.

</details>


### [254] [Ego-METAS: Egocentric online Multimodal Energy-efficient Temporal Action Segmentation benchmark](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.02246)
*Maria Santos-Villafranca,Jesus Bermudez-cameo,Alejandro Perez-Yus,Giovanni Maria Farinella,Antonino Furnari*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出Ego-METAS，首个面向在线时序动作分割的多模态能效基准，包含100多小时第一视角视频、5种模态数据，要求模型在严格能耗预算下动态选择传感器，实验表明最优路由高度依赖场景，现有方法难以适应连续环境，但简单动态融合即可有效平衡准确率与能耗。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有研究大多假设无限计算资源，忽视了资源受限设备上具身智能体的能效感知问题，缺乏面向在线、连续场景的多模态能效基准。

Method: 构建Ego-METAS基准，整合EgoExo4D、CMU-MMAC、CaptainCook4D三大数据集，提供RGB、音频、注视、IMU、单色相机5种模态，定义在线时序动作分割任务，要求模型在能耗预算约束下动态选择传感器。

Result: 最优路由策略高度依赖具体场景；现有基于修剪片段设计的策略学习方法难以适应连续未修剪环境；即使简单的随机路由动态融合也能有效平衡预测准确率与能耗。

Conclusion: Ego-METAS为资源受限、始终在线的具身AI系统提供了标准化基准，推动鲁棒、成本感知的策略学习研究。

Abstract: To operate in the physical world, embodied agents must perceive their environment in an "always-on" fashion, selectively accessing the most informative sensors to balance energy constraints and task accuracy. Despite its importance for resource-constrained devices, energy-aware perception remains under-explored, with most prior work assuming unlimited compute. To address this, we introduce Ego-METAS: the first Egocentric online Multimodal Energy-efficient Temporal Action Segmentation benchmark. Ego-METAS provides a unified testbed of more than 100 hours of untrimmed egocentric video from EgoExo4D, CMU-MMAC, and CaptainCook4D, spanning 5 modalities (RGB, audio, gaze, IMU, and monochrome camera). We formulate an online temporal action segmentation task where models must dynamically select which sensors to activate at each timestep while strictly adhering to hardware-representative energy budgets. Alongside the benchmark, we release unified splits, cleaned annotations, pre-extracted features, and a diverse suite of baseline routing policies. Our evaluations show that optimal routing is highly scenario-dependent, and that existing policy-learning methods, designed primarily for trimmed clips, struggle to adapt to continuous, untrimmed environments. However, even simple dynamic fusion of complementary modalities (e.g., via random routing) proves critical for balancing predictive accuracy against strict energy budgets. Ultimately, Ego-METAS provides a standardized foundation to develop robust, cost-aware policies for autonomous, always-on embodied AI.

</details>


### [255] [From Extrinsic to Intrinsic: Geodesic-Guided Representation Learning for 3D Geometric Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.02268)
*Yuming Zhao,Junhui Hou,Qijian Zhang,Jia Qin,Ying He*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: PRISM是一种新的3D表示学习范式，通过恢复内在表面测地度量来学习等距嵌入，在形状识别、表面参数化和非刚性对应等下游任务中表现出色。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有3D表示学习主要依赖外在空间结构或高层语义，难以捕捉形状身份的本质和底层流形拓扑，缺乏对内在几何特性的有效建模。

Method: PRISM通过拓扑强制目标约束潜在空间结构，并设计两阶段训练策略缓解测地距离分布中的样本不平衡问题，从而学习等距嵌入。

Result: 在测地距离预测上达到满意的准确性、鲁棒性和高效率，在形状识别、表面参数化和非刚性对应等下游任务中取得优越性能。

Conclusion: PRISM有效弥合了外在表示与内在几何之间的鸿沟，为3D表示学习提供了新的视角，代码已开源。

Abstract: Geometric analysis fundamentally distinguishes between \textit{extrinsic} and \textit{intrinsic} perspectives. The dominant paradigm in current 3D representation learning relies on either extrinsic spatial structures or high-level semantics, struggling to capture the essence of shape identity and underlying manifold topology. To bridge this gap, we introduce a novel 3D representation learning paradigm, namely \textbf{PRISM}, for \textbf{P}re-training, which learns isometric embeddings by \textbf{R}ecovering the \textbf{I}ntrinsic \textbf{S}urface geodesic \textbf{M}etric. PRISM incorporates a topology-enforcing objective that explicitly constrains the structure of latent space, alongside a specialized two-stage training recipe mitigating sample imbalance inherent in the distribution of geodesic distances. Experiments demonstrate that our approach shows satisfactory accuracy, robustness, and high efficiency in geodesic distance prediction and achieves superior performance across diverse downstream tasks, including shape recognition, surface parameterization, and non-rigid correspondence. The code will be publicly available at https://github.com/AidenZhao/PRISM.

</details>


### [256] [Vision-language Models for Driver Monitoring Systems: A Driver Activity Description Dataset](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.02273)
*David J. Lerch,Sarath Mulugurthi,Manuel Martin,Frederik Diederichs,Rainer Stiefelhagen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文针对现有视觉语言模型（VLM）难以识别细微驾驶行为的问题，创建了Drive&Act数据集的细粒度自然语言版本，并微调VLM使其在驾驶行为理解上显著提升（ACCR得分从66提升到76），同时跨数据集验证了其泛化能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有VLM在通用数据集上训练，无法准确识别驾驶员行为的细微差异，而理解精细的驾驶动作对于构建可靠的驾驶员监控系统至关重要。

Method: 1) 将Drive&Act数据集转化为详细的自然语言描述版本；2) 使用LLM评分方法评估三个VLM的性能；3) 基于标注数据创建包含细粒度描述的Drive&Act描述数据集；4) 在该数据集上微调VLM；5) 在Driver Monitoring Dataset (DMD)上进行跨数据集评估。

Result: 微调后的VLM在ACCR得分上达到76，显著优于零样本VLM基线的66分。跨数据集评估表明微调模型对DMD数据集中的动作具有良好的泛化能力。

Conclusion: 用丰富描述的驾驶行为数据适配VLM可以显著提升其解释驾驶员行为的能力，同时需要更多样化的数据集以支持更广泛的泛化应用。

Abstract: Understanding subtle driver actions is essential for building reliable driver monitoring systems. Existing visionlanguage models (VLMs) are trained on general datasets and struggle to recognize fine distinctions in driver behaviors. This paper addresses this limitation by creating a detailed natural language version of the Drive&Act dataset. We evaluate three VLMs on our new benchmark using LLM-based scoring methods. Their performance on the new benchmark shows that they cannot reliably generate accurate fine-grained driver activity descriptions. Based on the labeled Drive&Act dataset we create a new Drive&Act description dataset containing finegrained descriptions to train VLMs on driver activity understanding. Cross dataset evaluation on the Driver Monitoring Dataset (DMD) shows that the VLM fine-tuned on our new Drive&Act description dataset generalizes well to actions in the DMD dataset. The VLM fine-tuned on our Drive&Act description dataset achieves an ACCR score of 76 outperforming the zero-shot VLM baseline with an ACCR score of 66. These findings demonstrate that adapting VLMs with richly described driver actions can significantly improve their ability to interpret driver behavior while also highlighting the need for more diverse datasets to support broader generalization in future applications. Our Drive&Act description dataset and code will be publicly available on GitHub.

</details>


### [257] [Neural Acquisition & Representation of Subsurface Scattering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.02292)
*Arjun Majumdar,Raphael Braun,Hendrik Lensch*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出了一种通过学习物体表面每个点的像素足迹响应来获取和估计高细节层次次表面散射光传输属性的方法，使用U-Net CNN和3D扫描技术，通过立体投影仪-相机设置采集数据，实现高分辨率重光照。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法难以高效获取高细节层次次表面散射属性，需要一种能够捕捉密集像素足迹并泛化到未知散射材料的方法。

Method: 使用立体投影仪-相机系统结合相移轮廓测量(PSP)图案采集数据，以3D扫描技术作为输入，通过U-Net CNN学习每个点上的像素足迹响应，重建密集像素足迹以实现任意高分辨率投影图案的重光照。

Result: 预测的像素足迹与实际响应几乎一致，定性定量比较均验证了方法有效性，且模型可泛化到未见过的次表面散射材料。

Conclusion: 该方法能够高效获取高细节层次散射属性，实现高质量重光照，并具备对新材料的泛化能力。

Abstract: We present a method to acquire and estimate the sub-surface scattering properties of light transport at a highly detailed level by learning the pixel footprint response at each point on the object surface. The reconstruction leverages 3D scanning techniques as input to a U-Net CNN. A stereo projector-camera setup using phase-shifted profilometry (PSP) patterns efficiently captures the data for a variety of scattering objects. Reconstructing dense pixel footprints allows for relighting with arbitrary high-resolution projector patterns. The final output is a relit color image. Qualitative and quantitative comparison against illuminated real-world captured images demonstrate that the predicted footprints are almost identical to the actual responses. The same model is trained for multiple views across multiple objects such that the learned representations can be used to generalize to unseen sub-surface scattering materials as well.

</details>


### [258] [Cross-Domain Dead Tree Detection via Knowledge Distillation in Aerial Imagery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.02303)
*Anis Ur Rahman,Mete Ahishali,Einari Heinaro,Samuli Junttila*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出基于知识蒸馏的TreeMort-1T-UNet模型，通过特征级蒸馏等方法在不同森林数据集上实现跨域迁移，有效提升树木死亡检测的精度和域泛化能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 航空影像中的枯死树检测对评估森林健康至关重要，但领域差异大且标注数据稀缺，限制了模型的泛化能力，因此需要一种可扩展的域自适应方法。

Method: 基于TreeMort-1T-UNet模型，采用知识蒸馏（包含Basic、Self、Feature-level、Ensemble四种变体）在芬兰、波兰、德国、爱沙尼亚等数据集上进行跨域迁移，并通过Mean Tree IoU、Instance F1-score等指标及表征分析（CKA、SSIM、t-SNE、线性探针等）评估效果。

Result: 特征级知识蒸馏表现最佳：波兰数据集上Mean Tree IoU为0.106，Instance F1-score为0.63，精确率0.55；跨域表现稳健；低数据场景下假阳性更少；深层CKA/SSIM更高，t-SNE域混合更好，线性探针AUC达0.95。

Conclusion: 知识蒸馏能够有效增强遥感领域的迁移学习，特征级蒸馏在跨域树木死亡检测中兼顾精度与稳健性，为生态监测和可持续森林管理提供了可扩展的工具。

Abstract: Detecting dead trees in aerial imagery is vital for assessing forest health, especially as tree mortality increases globally due to climate change, but domain variability and scarce labeled data often limit model generalization. This study advances the TreeMort-1T-UNet (Tree Mortality 1-Task U-Net) model, initially trained on Finnish aerial imagery (source domain), by applying knowledge distillation (KD) to adapt it to various target domains, including Polish, German, and Estonian datasets representing diverse forest types. We assess four KD variants: Basic, Self, Feature-level, and Ensemble, against a fine-tuning baseline, using Mean Tree IoU, Instance F1-score, Instance Precision, and Mean Centroid Error as key metrics, alongside representational analyses (e.g., cosine similarity, CKA, SSIM, t-SNE, and linear probing) for domain invariance. Feature-level KD outperforms others, yielding a Mean Tree IoU of 0.106, Instance F1-score of 0.63, Instance Precision of 0.55, and Mean Centroid Error of 3.039 on the Polish dataset, with robust precision across other target domains (e.g., 0.15 on Finnish, 0.67 on Polish, 0.60 on German, 0.59 on Estonian). It excels in low-data scenarios with fewer false positives and shows superior representational invariance (e.g., higher deep-layer CKA/SSIM, better domain mixing in t-SNE, and linear probing AUC of 0.95), making it ideal for precision-critical forestry applications. Additional ablation studies confirm that key components like feature alignment enhance its performance balance across metrics. Our findings demonstrate KD's potential to enhance transfer learning in remote sensing, offering a scalable, domain-robust tool for ecological monitoring and sustainable forest management.

</details>


### [259] [Deep Learning for Remote Sensing to Improve Flood Inundation Mapping](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.02310)
*Yogesh Bhattarai,Vijay Chaudhary,Wai Lim Kim,Sanjib Sharma*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于去噪扩散概率模型（Masked Diffusion Transformer架构）的云去除框架，用于洪水遥感影像，有效恢复被云遮挡区域的水体信息，提升洪水监测的连续性和可靠性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 光学卫星影像在极端降水事件期间常受云层遮挡，传统云去除方法（如时间合成或插值）难以捕捉洪水动态变化，急需一种能保留视觉保真度和水文一致性的云去除方法。

Method: 采用基于Masked Diffusion Transformer架构的去噪扩散概率模型，利用自注意力机制捕获空间上下文，通过掩码token建模学习重建云遮挡区域，在真实云模式的多光谱Sentinel-2B洪水场景上训练。

Result: 模型生成的无云影像在视觉保真度和水文一致性上表现良好，水体的连续性和关键水检测指数的光谱特征得到改善，定量评估采用标准图像质量指标和洪水专用水文指标。

Conclusion: 基于扩散的生成模型为光学洪水监测中的云去除提供了一种鲁棒且物理一致的替代方案，能够支持更可靠、连续的灾害风险管理与洪水决策。

Abstract: Flooding is the most pervasive natural disaster worldwide. Timely and accurate flood inundation mapping are essential for informing disaster risk management. Optical satellite missions provide high-resolution, multispectral observations critical for flood detection and inundation mapping. However, their operational utility is severely constrained by cloud cover during extreme precipitation events. Conventional cloud-removal techniques based on temporal compositing or interpolation often fail to capture inundation dynamics. In this study, we introduce a cloud-removal framework for flood imagery based on Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Models, leveraging the Masked Diffusion Transformer architecture. The proposed approach exploits self-attention mechanisms to capture wider spatial context and employs masked token modeling to explicitly learn the reconstruction of cloud-obscured regions. Trained on multispectral Sentinel-2B flood scenes with realistic cloud patterns, the model generates cloud-free image realizations that preserve both visual fidelity and hydrological consistency. Reconstruction performance is evaluated using standard image quality metrics alongside flood-specific hydrological measures, demonstrating improved continuity of water bodies and preservation of spectral signatures critical for water detection indices. The results indicate that diffusion-based generative modeling offers a robust and physically consistent alternative for cloud removal in optical flood monitoring, enabling more reliable, continuous observations to support disaster risk management and flood-related decision making.

</details>


### [260] [Training-Free Composed Video Retrieval via Visual Representation-Guided Video-LLM Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.02321)
*Yang Liu,Qianqian Xu,Peisong Wen,Siran Dai,Qingming Huang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种无需训练的组合视频检索框架，先用DINOv3筛选视觉候选，再用视频大语言模型判断指令匹配度，最后进行推理优化，在CVPR 2026挑战赛上取得48.78% R@1和51.48% R@5。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视频检索从简单文本搜索扩展到用户可通过视觉示例和文本指令共同指定需求的灵活场景，需要一种能够同时理解参考视频和修改指令的检索方法。

Method: 首先使用冻结的DINOv3模型获取紧凑的视觉相关候选集，然后利用大视觉语言模型评估每个候选是否满足修改指令，最后对top候选进行基于推理的精细化优化以提升首位预测准确率。

Result: 在测试集上Recall@1达到48.78%，Recall@5达到51.48%。

Conclusion: 提出的无训练框架在组合视频检索任务上有效，未来可通过更强的视频大语言模型以及视觉表示与语言推理的更深度融合来进一步提升检索精度。

Abstract: Recent advances in large vision-language models have expanded video retrieval from simple text-based search to more flexible scenarios, where users may specify the desired result through both visual examples and textual instructions. In the CVPR 2026 Reason-Aware Composed Video Retrieval Challenge, the system is required to retrieve a target video according to a reference video and a modification instruction. To address this task, we develop Visual Representation-Guided Video-LLM Reasoning for Training-Free Composed Video Retrieval. Our framework first uses frozen DINOv3 models to obtain a compact set of visually relevant candidates, and then applies large vision-language models to evaluate whether each candidate satisfies the modification instruction. A final reasoning-based refinement is further performed on the top candidates to improve the first-ranked prediction. Without training, our system achieves 48.78 Recall@1 and 51.48 Recall@5 on the test set. Future work may further improve retrieval accuracy through stronger video-LLMs and detailed integration between visual representations and language reasoning.

</details>


### [261] [Hallucination-Aware Diffusion Sampling for Inverse Problems via Robust Prior Updates](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.02331)
*Pengfei Jin,Yiqi Tian,Kailong Fan,Bingjie Qi,Quanzheng Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种名为 Robust Prior Update (RPU) 的模块，通过稳定扩散模型中的先验更新步骤，减少逆问题求解中的测量条件幻觉（hallucination），提升了重建结果的忠实度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于扩散的逆问题求解器虽然能生成逼真的重建结果，但逼真不代表恢复的细节有测量数据支持。现有方法存在测量条件幻觉问题，即生成视觉上合理但与实际测量不一致的内容。

Method: 将基于贝叶斯规则的扩散逆求解器分解为先验更新和测量条件化两步，提出 RPU 模块：探测扩散先验更新的局部稳定性，将得到的位移重新锚定到当前迭代点，同时保持测量更新不变。在 DPS 框架中实现，并在 FFHQ 和 ImageNet 上进行评估。

Result: 在 FFHQ 的框内修复、高斯去模糊和运动去模糊任务中，RPU 相比 DPS 提升了 PSNR 和 LPIPS。人类评估中，FFHQ 框内修复任务 RPU 获得 91.9% 盲选偏好和 91.1% 有参考偏好。ImageNet 高斯去模糊研究虽平局较多，但非平局案例中 RPU 占优。

Conclusion: 增强先验更新的鲁棒性可以提升扩散逆求解器的实例忠实度，尤其是在先验主导弱约束内容时效果显著。

Abstract: Diffusion-based inverse problem solvers can produce realistic reconstructions, but realism alone does not ensure that the recovered details are supported by the measurement. We study this failure as measurement-conditioned hallucination: visually meaningful content that is either implausible or inconsistent with the measured instance. Our analysis separates Bayes-rule-based diffusion inverse solvers into a prior update and a measurement-conditioning step, showing that hallucinated content can enter through the prior-side proposal before the measurement correction is applied. Motivated by this view, we propose Robust Prior Update (RPU), a solver-level module that probes the local stability of the diffusion prior update, re-anchors the resulting displacement at the current iterate, and leaves the measurement update unchanged. We instantiate RPU in DPS and evaluate it on FFHQ and ImageNet inverse problems using automatic metrics and human faithfulness studies. On FFHQ, RPU improves PSNR and LPIPS over DPS across box inpainting, Gaussian deblurring, and motion deblurring. In human judgments, RPU receives 91.9% of blind non-tie majority preferences and 91.1% of ground-truth-assisted non-tie preferences on FFHQ box inpainting, while the ImageNet Gaussian reader study is tie-heavy but favors RPU among non-tie cases. These results support a targeted claim: robustifying the prior update can improve instance faithfulness in diffusion inverse solvers, especially when the prior shapes weakly constrained content.

</details>


### [262] [Detecting Pen-In-Air States from Video: A Proof-of-Concept Toward Complementary Handwriting Analysis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.02342)
*Lauren Sismeiro,Remy Plastre,Binbin Xu,Frederic Puyjarinet,Gerard Dray*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文探索了使用俯视视频结合YOLO追踪和机器学习分类来检测书写笔离地状态（Pen-Up），作为数字化平板的低成本非侵入式补充方案，在手动标注数据集上取得了最高0.805的F₂分数。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 数字化平板只能检测短距离内的笔离地行为，无法捕捉高抬笔运动，限制了对手写障碍等发育性障碍的动态评估能力。

Method: 提出可解释的混合流水线：基于YOLO的笔尖追踪 + 运动特征提取 + 机器学习分类；采用逐帧人工标注的试点数据集和留一视频交叉验证（LOVO）协议进行评估。

Result: Pen-Up片段的事件级检测F₂分数最高达0.805，在注重召回率的筛查场景中表现一致。

Conclusion: 视频方法可作为数字化平板的低成本非侵入式互补方案，为未来大规模研究奠定基础。

Abstract: Dynamic aspects of handwriting are critical for assessing developmental disorders such as dysgraphia and are typically captured using digitizing tablets. However, tablet-based sensing restricts analysis of Pen-Up behavior to a short proximity range above the writing surface, potentially missing high-lift in-air movements. As a proof of concept, we investigate whether top-view video can provide a complementary source of information for inferring pen-contact states without relying on tablet proximity sensing. We propose an interpretable hybrid pipeline combining pen-tip tracking using a YOLO-based detector with kinematic feature extraction and machine learning classification. A pilot dataset of diverse handwriting videos was manually annotated at the frame level and evaluation used a Leave-One-Video-Out (LOVO) protocol. The method achieved reliable event-level detection of Pen-Up segments, with an F_2 score up to 0.805, consistent with the emphasis on recall in a screening-oriented setting. These results support the feasibility of video-based Pen-Up detection as a low-cost and non-intrusive complement to digitizing tablets, and provide a foundation for future large-scale studies.

</details>


### [263] [VEDAL: Variational Error-Driven Asynchronous Learning for 3D Gaussian Splatting Pruning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.02346)
*Aoduo Li,Jiancheng Li,Huan Ye,Hongjian Xu,Shiting Wu,Xiujun Zhang,Zimeng Li,Xuhang Chen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: VEDAL 将3D高斯剪枝形式化为变分自由能最小化，通过预测误差门控机制和变分不确定性头实现高效压缩，在保持185 FPS实时渲染的同时达成5.2倍压缩比，PSNR仅下降0.31 dB。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 3DGS虽能实现高质量实时新视图合成，但数百万高斯原语导致内存消耗过大；现有剪枝方法依赖启发式重要性分数或同步批量更新，导致压缩次优和训练不稳定。

Method: (1) 预测误差门控机制：基于逐高斯重建不确定性异步激活剪枝；(2) 变分不确定性头：将剪枝决策建模为具有可学习先验的潜变量；(3) 自由能目标函数：通过信息论视角自然平衡重建保真度与模型复杂度。

Result: 在Mip-NeRF 360、Tanks&Temples和Deep Blending数据集上，VEDAL实现5.2倍压缩，PSNR仅下降0.31 dB；比PUP 3D-GS高0.05 dB且压缩比更高，比LightGaussian高0.35 dB；渲染速度185 FPS。

Conclusion: VEDAL是一种原则性的高斯剪枝框架，通过变分自由能最小化在压缩率、重建质量和实时渲染之间取得了更优的平衡。

Abstract: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) achieves remarkable novel view synthesis quality with real-time rendering, yet suffers from excessive memory consumption due to millions of Gaussian primitives. Existing pruning methods rely on heuristic importance scores or synchronous batch updates, leading to suboptimal compression and training instability. We propose VEDAL, a principled framework that formulates Gaussian pruning as variational free energy minimization. Our approach introduces (1) a prediction-error gating mechanism that asynchronously activates pruning based on per-Gaussian reconstruction uncertainty, and (2) a variational uncertainty head that models pruning decisions as latent variables with learnable priors. The free energy objective naturally balances reconstruction fidelity against model complexity through an information-theoretic lens. Extensive experiments on Mip-NeRF 360, Tanks&Temples, and Deep Blending demonstrate that VEDAL achieves 5.2x compression with only 0.31 dB PSNR drop, outperforming PUP 3D-GS by +0.05 dB at a higher compression ratio and LightGaussian by +0.35 dB at comparable quality, while maintaining real-time rendering at 185 FPS.

</details>


### [264] [TROPHIES: Temporal Reconstruction of Places, Humans, and Cameras from Multi-view Videos](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.02350)
*Jinpeng Liu,Yukang Xu,Yutong Li,Xingyu Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出TROPHIES框架，从多视角视频中统一重建动态人体、静态场景和相机位姿，实现全局一致的4D空间感知。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法大多假设单视角输入或解耦人体、场景和相机，无法恢复一致的几何、稳定的运动和物理对齐的轨迹。

Method: TROPHIES包含人体分支（时空推理建模人体）和场景分支（人体感知注意力重建静态几何），并通过全局对齐优化模块强制执行尺度一致性、接触先验和跨视角时间一致性来耦合两个分支。

Result: 在EgoHuman和EgoExo4D数据集上，TROPHIES实现了全局对齐、物理合理的4D重建，在全局保真度和人-场景一致性上持续优于现有方法。

Conclusion: 多视角视频下的人-场景-相机统一重建是可行的，且TROPHIES框架有效实现了全局一致的4D感知。

Abstract: Reconstructing humans and their surrounding environments in a globally consistent 4D space is essential for comprehensive perception. However, prior works typically assume single-view inputs or decouple humans, scenes, and cameras, making them unable to recover coherent geometry, stable motion, and physically aligned trajectories. These limitations motivate us to introduce a new task: unified human-scene-camera reconstruction from multi-view videos, which aims to jointly estimate dynamic humans, static scenes, and camera poses in one global coordinate frame. We propose TROPHIES--Temporal Reconstruction of Places, Humans, and Cameras from Multi-view Videos-a unified framework tailored for this task. TROPHIES features a Human Branch that models humans through temporal and spatial reasoning, and a Scene Branch that reconstructs static geometry with human-aware attention. A global alignment and optimization module couples both branches by enforcing scale consistency, contact priors, and cross-view temporal coherence. Experiments on EgoHuman and EgoExo4D demonstrate that TROPHIES achieves globally aligned, physically plausible 4D reconstructions and consistently outperforms existing paradigms in both global fidelity and human-scene consistency.

</details>


### [265] [Multi-modal Video Representation Alignment for Robust Self-supervised Driver Distraction Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.02352)
*David J. Lerch,Livien Majer,Zeyun Zhong,Manuel Martin,Frederik Diederichs,Rainer Stiefelhagen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种面向多模态视频表示的鲁棒自监督学习框架，通过软目标和加权机制分别处理错误负样本和不可靠正样本，在Drive&Act数据集上优于现有方法，特别适用于驾驶员分心检测等现实场景。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统对比学习如InfoNCE假设所有负样本同样有信息量、所有正样本都可靠，但在多模态数据中（如视角变化、遮挡、模态间语义重叠）这一假设经常被违反，导致表征学习不鲁棒。

Method: (1) 提出基于循环一致性得分的软目标来放宽硬负样本假设；(2) 设计基于相似度分布的加权机制来缓解噪声/错误正样本的影响；(3) 将传统成对对齐扩展到全局多模态对齐，聚合所有模态对之间的对齐信息。

Result: 在Drive&Act数据集上，该方法在RGB、IR、Depth、Skeleton多种模态上一致优于成对对齐和现有全局对齐基线；跨视角消融实验表明其对未见过的摄像头视角具有强泛化能力。

Conclusion: 该框架为自监督全局多模态表征学习提供了可扩展且有效的解决方案，能够实现可靠的驾驶员分心检测，推动了现实世界多模态视频理解的发展。

Abstract: Robust self-supervised learning of multi-modal video representations is critical for real-world applications such as driver distraction detection, where multiple sensors provide complementary but noisy signals. Conventional contrastive objectives, such as InfoNCE, assume all negatives are equally informative and all positives are reliable. However, this assumption is frequently violated in multi-modal data due to viewpoint changes, occlusions, or semantic overlap across modalities. In this work, we propose a novel framework for multi-modal global alignment that addresses these challenges by jointly modeling faulty negatives and unreliable or faulty positives. We introduce soft targets derived from cycle-consistency scores to relax the hard-negative assumption, and a weighting mechanism based on similarity distributions to mitigate the impact of noisy or faulty positives. Our approach extends traditional pairwise alignment to a principled global multi-modal setting, aggregating alignment information across all modality pairs. We evaluate our method on the Drive&Act dataset, demonstrating that it consistently outperforms both pairwise and existing global alignment baselines across RGB, IR, Depth, and Skeleton modalities. Cross-view ablation studies further show strong generalization to unseen camera perspectives, highlighting the robustness of our representations. Overall, our framework provides a scalable and effective solution for self-supervised global multi-modal representation learning, enabling reliable driver distraction detection and pioneering in real-world multi-modal video understanding. Our code will be published on GitHub.

</details>


### [266] [Do Multimodal Agents Really Benefit from Tool Use? A Systematic Study of Capability Gains](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.02357)
*Garvin Guo,Donglei Yu,Yu Chen,Xiang Wang,Shuai Li,Xinpei Zhao,Huaxing Liu,Qinghao Wang,Minpeng Liao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文质疑了工具增强多模态智能体的有效性问题，通过对比实验发现，当前流行的"视觉思维"智能体在使用工具时并未带来显著的性能提升，大部分工具解决的问题其实无需工具也能被其他设置解决，智能体更多是学会了调用工具的模式而非工具本身带来的能力增益。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有研究通常认为工具调用轨迹证明了智能体学会了使用工具，但这种解读可能为时过早——工具调用本身并不能证明工具提供了答案所需的关键信息。因此有必要验证工具是否真正扩展了智能体的解决问题的能力。

Method: 选取Thyme和DeepEyesV2两种代表性"视觉思维"智能体，在真实世界理解、OCR、图表理解和数学推理四个任务上，分别与无工具版本、纯文本推理器进行对比。通过聚合性能、生成代价、工具独解集分析以及机制消融实验，全面评估工具的实际贡献。

Result: 工具访问带来少量且不一致的聚合改进；无法稳定降低生成token成本；工具独解集极小（DeepEyesV2仅7%，Thyme仅4%的问题需工具才能解决）；机制消融表明完整工具使用循环并不优于仅工具调用格式或仅执行结果。

Conclusion: 在所研究的设置下，被分析智能体更可靠地学会了工具调用的模式，而非工具带来的实际能力增益。评估应区分工具的可访问性与工具是否真正扩展了智能体的解题能力。

Abstract: Tool-augmented multimodal agents show strong benchmark gains, often taken as evidence that agents have learned to use tools. We argue that this interpretation can be premature: a tool-call trace alone does not show whether the tool supplied answer-critical information. We study two representative ``thinking with images'' agents, Thyme and DeepEyesV2, across real-world understanding, OCR, chart understanding, and mathematical reasoning. Each agent is compared with its Tool-Free counterpart and with a Pure-Text Reasoner trained from the same source pool without tool-calling trajectories. Tool access yields little consistent aggregate improvement, does not reliably reduce generated-token cost, and leaves only a small tool-only solved set: 93% of DeepEyesV2's tool-solved problems and 96% of Thyme's are also solved by at least one non-tool setting. Mechanism ablations further show that the full tool-use loop does not consistently outperform either the tool-call format or the returned execution result alone. In the settings we study, the analyzed agents appear to learn tool-calling patterns more reliably than tool-contributed capabilities, suggesting that evaluation should distinguish tool availability from whether tools actually expand what agents can solve.

</details>


### [267] [PRIMA: Boosting Animal Mesh Recovery with Biological Priors and Test-Time Adaptation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.02366)
*Xiaohang Yu,Ti Wang,Mackenzie Weygandt Mathis*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: PRIMA是一个利用生物先验知识（BioCLIP嵌入）和测试时自适应策略，实现鲁棒的四足动物网格重建的框架。它通过引入生物先验、测试时自适应和构建大规模伪3D数据集Quadruped3D，显著提升了稀有物种和罕见姿态下的重建效果，在多个基准上达到SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有动物重建方法因3D监督数据有限且物种分布呈长尾特征，常退化为预测平均形状和姿态，对稀有物种和罕见关节姿态泛化能力差。

Method: 1) 引入BioCLIP嵌入作为生物先验，注入语义和形态学知识；2) 提出测试时自适应策略，利用2D重投影约束和辅助关键点引导优化SMAL预测；3) 基于该框架构建大规模伪3D数据集Quadruped3D，覆盖多样物种和姿态变化。

Result: 在Animal3D、CtrlAni3D、Quadruped2D和Animal Kingdom等数据集上达到SOTA，在稀有物种和挑战性姿态上提升尤为显著。

Conclusion: 生物先验和自适应驱动的数据扩展对于可扩展、可泛化的动物网格重建至关重要。

Abstract: We present PRIMA (*PRI*ors for *M*esh *A*daptation), a framework for robust 3D quadruped mesh recovery under severe species and pose imbalance. Existing animal reconstruction methods often regress toward mean shapes and poses due to limited 3D supervision and long-tailed species distributions, resulting in poor generalization to underrepresented animals and rare articulations. PRIMA addresses this challenge through three key contributions. First, we incorporate BioCLIP embeddings as biological priors to inject semantic and morphological knowledge into the reconstruction process, enabling more accurate and generalizable shape prediction across diverse quadrupeds. Second, we introduce a test-time adaptation (TTA) strategy that refines SMAL predictions using 2D reprojection constraints together with auxiliary keypoint guidance, improving pose and shape estimation while enabling the generation of high-quality pseudo-3D annotations from existing 2D datasets. Third, leveraging this TTA framework, we construct Quadruped3D, a large-scale pseudo-3D dataset that covers diverse species and pose variations to systematically improve model performance. Extensive experiments on Animal3D, CtrlAni3D, Quadruped2D, and Animal Kingdom demonstrate that PRIMA achieves state-of-the-art results, with particularly strong improvements on underrepresented species and challenging poses. Our results highlight the importance of biological priors and adaptation-driven data expansion for scalable and generalizable animal mesh recovery. Code is available at https://github.com/AdaptiveMotorControlLab/PRIMA.

</details>


### [268] [Honey, I Shrunk the Arc de Triomphe!](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.02379)
*Yuanbo Xiangli,Hanyu Chen,Xueqing Tsang,Noah Snavely*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文针对单目度量几何估计中的"尺度坍缩"问题，提出了一个新的大规模度量数据集MetricScenes，通过多源数据收集和两阶段泊松补全方法提升深度图质量，微调后的MoGe-2模型有效缓解了尺度坍缩现象，在开放场景中取得更优的度量精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前度量尺度单目几何估计基础模型存在"尺度坍缩"问题（远处地标和广阔景观被度量低估），其根本原因是训练数据瓶颈——现有度量数据集受硬件限制，要么是车辆采集的激光雷达数据或短距离室内扫描，要么是缺乏真实世界语义复杂性的合成数据。

Method: 1) 构建MetricScenes数据集：从互联网照片集和立体图像等多源渠道收集数据，利用现成方法估计相机位姿和初始深度图，通过地理标记元数据和立体相机基线恢复绝对尺度；2) 提出两阶段泊松补全方法提升深度图质量；3) 在MetricScenes上微调MoGe-2模型。

Result: 微调后的MoGe-2模型显著缓解了尺度坍缩问题，在无约束开放域场景中实现了更优的度量精度，同时在标准基准测试上保持了最先进的性能水平。

Conclusion: 通过构建大规模、真实世界的度量尺度数据集MetricScenes，有效解决了单目度量估计中的尺度坍缩问题，证明了数据多样性和质量对提升模型泛化能力的重要性。
